screens.shows: Inside a project: the session list by Needs you, Open, Today, This week, then the Earlier, Tasks and Archived folds; a task row open on its sessions; a group; + New task.
Every session-list row and fold, one per box.
All projects with a Home: Home's columns, then OUTSIDE HOME columns by path; Open tasks in the action column.
First launch with no Home folder: the map lists every folder; the left pane explains Home once.
The Move into Home sheet over All projects.
The right pane on a task note: the properties block with its linked sessions' live states, and a session link in the text.
The action column with nothing waiting, with reasons, and with a long question.
